repo_classes.why: The core artifact is a Markdown design-skill/ruleset; the included static showcase site is supporting documentation rather than an engineering system.
An original, single-purpose Next.js image-generation integration with a visible 144-commit development history.
A maintained, multi-provider CLI with release, test, and extension surfaces.
A small original challenge submission using standard k-NN/CNN library workflows, not a course repository.
Its README explicitly says it is based on Adrian Hajdin's video tutorial.
A multi-package local proxy/daemon system, though visible recent implementation is substantially co-authored.

reach_non_code.why: The primary deliverable is design guidance/skill documentation, not an engineering artifact.

exceptional.note: roomGPT's forks and stars show exceptional distribution of a reusable code project; they do not by themselves establish difficult systems engineering.

headline: A prolific AI-product and developer-tool builder with one mature CLI, strong distribution, and uneven evidence of personally authored deep systems work.
evidence: aicommits/src/feature/generate-commit-message.ts imposes explicit diff, path, time, model-call, and agent-step budgets; tests/specs/generate-commit-message.ts exercises staged-versus-unstaged isolation and mocked provider flows.
aicommits has 372 commits, 67 releases, CI, tests, and was maintained from February 2023 through August 2026; it has 9,090 stars and 476 forks.
roomGPT has 144 commits over 469 days and 10,666 stars / 1,497 forks; app/generate/route.ts includes server-side rate limiting and an asynchronous Replicate prediction lifecycle.

togetherlink/packages/cli/src/lib/daemon/server.ts handles a local HTTP/WebSocket daemon, session lifecycle, health probing, port races, and proxy routes; its 289-commit, typed, CI-tested repository includes compatibility and benchmark tests.
The account has 2,741 public commits across seven active years and 1,033 through the November 2022 cutoff, providing meaningful pre-ChatGPT development history.
against: roomGPT/app/generate/route.ts has an unbounded polling loop and weak response validation, while app/dream/page.tsx lacks a protective error/finally path; the repository has neither tests nor CI.

covid-classifier has 12 commits and 99% vendored content; nn_classifier.py evaluates on its training data, while covid-tracker is explicitly tutorial-followed, so the visible pre-AI code is not strong ML evidence.

The recent substantial changes shown for both aicommits and togetherlink are credited to riccardogiorato; togetherlink's README names two authors, limiting confidence that its current proxy architecture is Hassan's personal implementation.
ask_for: A commit-authorship breakdown or representative pre-2023 production code, plus direct evidence of Hassan's implementation role in aicommits and togetherlink, would confirm or raise the systems/devtools judgment.
